name: DS Cluster D21: EIA Route Taxonomy (Petroleum + Natural Gas)
description: Tests: economic_indicators with eia_route and eia_data_frequency for petroleum stocks, spot prices, natural gas storage, Henry Hub futures, ffill for sparse energy data.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D21: EIA Route Taxonomy
# =============================================================================
# All EIA series use economic_indicators(series_id=..., eia_route=..., eia_data_frequency=...).
# 16 validated routes: 10 petroleum, 6 natural gas (+ 2 more NG).

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === PETROLEUM: Weekly Crude Stocks ===
crude_stocks_src = economic_indicators(
    series_id="WCESTUS1",
    eia_route="petroleum/stoc/wstk",
    eia_data_frequency=EiaFrequency.Weekly
)()
crude_stocks = ffill(crude_stocks_src.result)

# === PETROLEUM: Gasoline Stocks ===
gas_stocks_src = economic_indicators(
    series_id="WGTSTUS1",
    eia_route="petroleum/stoc/wstk",
    eia_data_frequency=EiaFrequency.Weekly
)()
gas_stocks = ffill(gas_stocks_src.result)

# === PETROLEUM: WTI Spot Price ===
wti_spot_src = economic_indicators(
    series_id="RWTC",
    eia_route="petroleum/pri/spt",
    eia_data_frequency=EiaFrequency.Weekly
)()
wti_spot = ffill(wti_spot_src.result)

# === PETROLEUM: Brent Spot Price ===
brent_spot_src = economic_indicators(
    series_id="RBRTE",
    eia_route="petroleum/pri/spt",
    eia_data_frequency=EiaFrequency.Weekly
)()
brent_spot = ffill(brent_spot_src.result)

# === WTI-BRENT SPREAD ===
wti_brent_spread = wti_spot - brent_spot

# === NATURAL GAS: Weekly Storage ===
ng_storage_src = economic_indicators(
    series_id="NW2_EPG0_SWO_R48_BCF",
    eia_route="natural-gas/stor/wkly",
    eia_data_frequency=EiaFrequency.Weekly
)()
ng_storage = ffill(ng_storage_src.result)

# === NATURAL GAS: Henry Hub Futures ===
hhub_src = economic_indicators(
    series_id="RNGWHHD",
    eia_route="natural-gas/pri/fut",
    eia_data_frequency=EiaFrequency.Monthly
)()
hhub_price = ffill(hhub_src.result)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Crude Oil Stocks (EIA Weekly)",
    category="Petroleum",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Crude Stocks", color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=crude_stocks)

xy_lines(
    title="Gasoline Stocks (EIA Weekly)",
    category="Petroleum",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Gasoline Stocks", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=gas_stocks)

xy_lines(
    title="WTI vs Brent Spot Price",
    category="Petroleum",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="WTI", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Brent", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(wti_spot, brent_spot))

xy_lines(
    title="WTI-Brent Spread",
    category="Petroleum",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Spread", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Parity")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=wti_brent_spread)

xy_lines(
    title="Natural Gas Weekly Storage (BCF)",
    category="Natural Gas",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Working Gas", color=Color.Yellow)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ng_storage)

xy_lines(
    title="Henry Hub Futures Price",
    category="Natural Gas",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Henry Hub", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=hhub_price)
